scope: Selected filters in the T12 orientation examples, not all OrientationAnalysis filters.

filters.purpose: Import the public 2D steel map without rotating its acquisition frame; convert Euler angles from degrees to radians.
Accept pixels only when Phases > 0 AND Error == 0. Keep rejected measurements in the saved arrays but exclude them from segmentation.
Convert radians-based Euler orientations to quaternions for symmetry-aware segmentation and feature averaging.
Join face-connected valid pixels within a phase when pairwise misorientation is below 5 degrees. Keep the finite map nonperiodic and feature IDs unrandomized.
Measure every positive feature before reporting selection. With one Z cell and unit Z spacing, the size output is area and the diameter is an equivalent circle diameter.
Compute one symmetry-aware Rodrigues average per positive feature as the fixed reference for later orientation-spread comparisons; do not average Euler components directly.
Color accepted orientations relative to acquisition Z for visual context only; no loading-axis or strain inference is implied.
Save measured arrays, validity mask, unchanged segmentation, feature sizes, reporting mask, and average orientations as the shared checkpoint.
